rubrics.justification: Describes a fair blastocyst with loose ICM/less cohesive TE, which may fit 2BA, but it introduces uncertain or possibly fabricated image features such as vacuoles/extrusion/debris and questions the reported grade/day without clear visual basis.

Integrates age, BMI, FSH, tubal factor, prior live birth, endometrial thickness, and sperm motility into prognosis reasonably well, though AMH is unavailable and some links to embryo competence are somewhat speculative.
Overall logic is understandable, but there are inconsistencies around calling the embryo day-4 yet a full blastocyst/2BA, and the prognosis is partly built on uncertain morphology interpretations.

Recommendations are largely consistent with IVF practice: single embryo transfer, standard luteal support, no routine bed rest, selective PGT-A, and uterine/male-factor review after failure. Minor deviation comes from overinterpreting morphology and day-stage ambiguity.

Provides practical next steps for current transfer and future planning, including SET, hydrosalpinx review, uterine evaluation, semen reassessment, and selective PGT-A; useful though not highly tailored beyond standard IVF management.
